This chain implies a possible indirect relationship where Amikacin may influence the course of disease through the use of Cefazolin. The evidence is supported by a moderate score (0.5787), indicating some level of confidence in the relationship, though the strength of the link remains uncertain. Further research would be needed to establish a direct causal relationship.
